sentences.text: A pair of carbohydrate esterases from Bacteroides cellulosilyticus was shown to together deacetylate complex beta-mannans, glycans widespread in the human diet.
In human cohort studies, the relative abundance of Bacteroides cellulosilyticus was significantly decreased in patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.
That study reported Bacteroides cellulosilyticus and its metabolite 2-hydroxyphenylacetic acid as key factors regulating the occurrence and development of that liver disease.
In cell culture, isolates of Bacteroides cellulosilyticus and Bacteroides xylanisolvens reduced inflammation in Caco-2 intestinal epithelial cells by lowering IL-8 and NF-kB transcription.
